The '''Coronet Capitol''' was the building situated in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]],<ref name="SWG" /> that was home to the [[Diktat]] and the [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] government.<ref name="SWG:BS" />

==History==
{{Quote|The missing shipment was at the capitol building? Unbelievable. I'll send some droids to go retrieve it. And the mystery crate contained spice? I'm astounded. Why in the world would a smuggled crate of spice end up at the capitol building? You don't think this involved the Diktat, do you? No, that's patently absurd, isn't it? I'll have to alert CorSec of all this.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper|Jasper]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RtMSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Reacquire the Missing Starship Component Shipment|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The capitol building was known to be in operation during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="SWG" /> and served as the governmental building following the destruction of the [[Coronet Capitol Tower]] around [[0 ABY/Legends|6]] [[Standard month/Legends|months]] [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].<ref name="Rogue">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Ragtags]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]] in the Coronet Capitol building.<ref name="SWG:RtMSC" /> This was part of a plot arranged by the [[Rogue CorSec]] to discredit the government and overthrow the Diktat [[Daclif Gallamby]].<ref name="SWG:RtToaGD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Receive the Thanks of a Grateful Diktat|Corellia}}</ref> The plot was foiled after a spacer working for [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]] discovered the spice and a shipment stolen from the businessman [[Ral Mundi]] in the Capitol.<ref name="SWG:RtMSC" />

Around the same time, some thieves entered the Capitol and stole a [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] that belong to an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]]. [[Gallura Handerin]], a government aide, hired a spacer to recover the armor before the officer could notice the robbery.<ref name="SWG:WftG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Working for the Government|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Coronet Capitol was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
